title: Paper Maze · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Maze · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead paper and pencil and choose a starting point and finish. The lead draws a simple maze with one continuous route from start to finish. A partner traces the intended route with a pencil without crossing a wall. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Maze, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
A partner traces the intended route with a pencil without crossing a wall.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: A partner traces the intended route with a pencil without crossing a wall.
